info.title: Automaker HTTP API
info.description: Generated from native controller routes and shared Zod input schemas. Incomplete inputs and unverified responses are explicitly marked; this is not a complete response contract. JSON Schema cannot express every Zod refinement: shared runtime schemas remain authoritative for validation.
